parameters.query: SELECT state, context_json FROM agenda.conversation_state WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint;
SELECT to_char(hora_inicio, 'HH24:MI') AS ini, to_char(hora_fin, 'HH24:MI') AS fin FROM agenda.bookings WHERE estado = 'confirmada' AND trabajador = $1 AND fecha = $2::date;

WITH del AS (DELETE FROM agenda.conversation_state WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND $2 = 'clear') INSERT INTO agenda.conversation_state (chat_id, state, context_json) SELECT $1::bigint, $3, convert_from(decode($4, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb WHERE $2 = 'set' ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE SET state = EXCLUDED.state, context_json = EXCLUDED.context_json, updated_at = now();
